verdict.rationale: Ente Auth's marketing explicitly advertises service icons ('Easily identify your tokens by their icons'), favoriting services to the top, and 'Don't scroll'. A changelog entry adding search deep links (enteauth://search) implies in-app search exists. However, folders or groups are backed only by the vague tagline 'Organize with ease', and all the organization evidence is short marketing copy rather than feature documentation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of folders/groups/tags, first-party docs describing how search works, and independent or hands-on corroboration of these organization features.
